title: 🤝 Several Community & Social Service Roles in New York City - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago New York City’s social service scene is busy and growing. If you care about housing, youth, or mental health support, there are a few solid ways to plug in right now.
Legacy Mentor — Retired Professionals Mentoring the Next Generation (Volunteer) Employer: Mentor A Promise (PromiseRise division) Location: Fully Remote (US-based) with NYC opportunities when available Type: Volunteer , approx. 5–10 hours/week , minimum 6‑month commitment This is a great fit for retired or semi‑retired professionals who want to give back by mentoring youth (ages 5–18) experiencing housing instability. You’ll share career and life lessons in a structured, trauma‑informed program , with training and clear boundaries provided.
Shift Supervisor Employer: Urban Pathways Location: New York, NY Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed You’ll oversee daily operations at a housing or shelter program , supervising front-line staff and supporting residents during your shift. Good for someone with team leadership , crisis response , and supportive housing or shelter experience , who can work evenings, nights, weekends, or holidays as needed.
